claims: The U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) is closed on Friday, April 3, 2026, in observance of Good Friday.
The U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) will reopen for regular hours on Monday, April 6, 2026.
The regular hours of the U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) are 9:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. ET.
The U.S. bond market is closed on April 3, 2026.
Banks are open as usual on April 3, 2026.
The U.S. Postal Service (USPS) is open as usual on April 3, 2026.
The next scheduled closure is for Memorial Day on Monday, May 25, 2026.
